As the facilities manager, arrange the company departments into distinct offices so that every department occupies a unique office and every office hosts a unique department, while keeping the overall cost from interdepartment interaction multiplied by office separation as small as possible.

As the museum curator, decide which artworks go on which display panels so that each artwork is placed on a unique panel and each panel shows a unique artwork, while minimizing visitor circulation cost based on how often pairs of pieces are seen together and how far apart their panels are.

As the call center operations lead, seat functional teams at distinct desk clusters so that every team is assigned to a unique cluster and every cluster contains a unique team, with the goal of minimizing overall interteam communication delay computed from call volumes and desk separations.

As the campus planner, allocate research groups to different buildings so that every group occupies a unique building and every building houses a unique group, minimizing the total collaboration travel cost derived from pairwise collaborative intensity and building distances.

As the airport operations manager, station check-in teams at distinct terminals so that every team is located at a unique terminal and every terminal contains a unique team, minimizing the aggregate passenger transfer inconvenience driven by connecting passenger flows and terminal distances.

As the inventory manager, assign frequently used tools to separate storage bins so that each tool type occupies a unique bin and each bin stores a unique tool type, with the aim of minimizing overall retrieval interaction cost arising from co-usage frequencies and bin separation.

As the props master, allocate stage props to different backstage rooms so that each prop set is stored in a unique room and every room holds a unique prop set, while minimizing the total movement cost involved in handing props between scenes based on how often pairs are moved and room distances.

As the farm manager, decide which crop varieties are planted in specific fields so that each variety is assigned to a unique field and each field grows a unique variety, minimizing the combined equipment transfer and management cost that comes from how often varieties share operations and the distances between fields.

As the exhibit designer, place interactive displays at distinct positions on the floor so that every display occupies a unique position and every position hosts a unique display, aiming to minimize visitor walking cost driven by pairwise attraction patterns and positional separations.

As the festival organizer, assign food vendors to stall locations so that each vendor is given a unique stall and every stall hosts a unique vendor, with the goal of minimizing overall patron travel cost based on how often vendor pairs are visited together and the spacing between stalls.

As the grid planner, position transformer units at distinct substation sites so that every transformer is installed at a unique site and every site accommodates a unique transformer, seeking to minimize the total transmission loss cost that depends on power exchange between transformers and distances between sites.

As the head librarian, place book categories on separate shelving areas so that each category occupies a unique area and each area holds a unique category, minimizing the sum of patron walking effort driven by co-borrowing frequencies and the separations between shelving areas.

global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the research groups that need benches. Each id denotes one group that must be assigned to a single bench.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the lab benches (locations). Each id denotes one bench that can host exactly one research group.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Source bench identifier in a bench-to-bench distance record. Together with bench_id_to identifies the ordered pair of benches whose separation is given.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Target bench identifier in a bench-to-bench distance record. Together with bench_id_from identifies the ordered pair of benches whose separation is given.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Physical separation or distance measure between the two benches (bench_id_from and bench_id_to). This separation is the distance factor used to compute overhead when groups assigned to those benches interact.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Source research-group identifier in an interaction record. Together with group_id_to identifies the ordered pair of groups whose interaction frequency is recorded.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Target research-group identifier in an interaction record. Together with group_id_from identifies the ordered pair of groups whose interaction frequency is recorded.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: How often the two groups (group_id_from and group_id_to) interact — e.g., collaboration events or communication count. This frequency is multiplied by the bench_distance between their assigned benches to compute that pair's contribution to total collaborative overhead.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of prop sets and storage spots (equal counts). This is the size of the assignment problem: each prop set must be placed in exactly one spot and each spot holds exactly one prop set.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each prop set that needs storage. These are the items to assign to storage spots; each id represents a distinct set of props used during production.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each physical storage spot/area. Each spot can hold exactly one prop set; assignments map prop_set_ids to storage_spot_ids.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin storage spot in a directed pair. Used with to_spot_id to specify which two spots the walking distance refers to.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination storage spot in a directed pair. Together with from_spot_id, it identifies the ordered pair of spots whose separation is measured.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: The walking time or distance from from_spot_id to to_spot_id (e.g., seconds or meters). This models how long it takes to move between those two storage areas when fetching props; it is multiplied by joint-fetch frequency to compute retrieval cost for a pair.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source prop set in a directed pair. Used with to_prop_set_id to indicate which two prop sets are fetched in sequence or together.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target prop set in a directed pair. Together with from_prop_set_id it identifies the ordered pair of prop sets whose joint retrieval frequency is measured.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: How often the pair (from_prop_set_id -> to_prop_set_id) is fetched together or in sequence (e.g., times per day or per shoot). This frequency is multiplied by the walking_time_between_spots of the assigned spots to get that pair's contribution to total retrieval time.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of medication families and dispensary drawers (they are equal). This is the size of the assignment permutation: each family must be placed into exactly one drawer and each drawer must receive exactly one family.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each medication family (one per family). These are the items to assign to drawers; every identifier must be mapped to a single drawer in the final assignment.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each dispensary drawer (one per drawer). Each drawer will hold exactly one medication family in the assignment.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Drawer identifier serving as the source in a drawer-to-drawer distance record.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Drawer identifier serving as the target in a drawer-to-drawer distance record (paired with from_drawer).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric distance or travel time between the two specified drawers (e.g., steps, meters, or seconds). When two medication families are assigned to these drawers, this value multiplies their co-prescription frequency to give their contribution to total dispensing delay.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Medication family identifier serving as the source in a co-prescription (flow) record.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Medication family identifier serving as the target in a co-prescription (flow) record (paired with from_family).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Frequency (count or weight) that the two specified medication families are prescribed together. This weight is multiplied by the distance between their assigned drawers to compute that pair's contribution to the total dispensing delay.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of repair kits and benches (they are equal). This is how many kits must be assigned so each bench holds exactly one kit.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each repair kit that must be placed on a bench. Each ID refers to a single kit.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each workbench where kits can be stationed. Each ID refers to a single bench.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source bench in a bench-to-bench distance record (where a technician might start walking).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target bench in a bench-to-bench distance record (where a technician might walk to).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric distance (or typical walking cost) between the two benches named by bench_from_id and bench_to_id — used to measure technician travel when kits used together are separated.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source repair kit in a kit-pair usage record (one of the two kits that are used together).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the other repair kit in a kit-pair usage record (the kit paired with kit_from_id).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric weight describing how often or how important the two kits (kit_from_id and kit_to_id) are used together — higher means more walking cost if they are far apart.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of workshops (which equals the number of available rooms). This is how many one-to-one workshop→room assignments the solver must produce.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Array of workshop identifiers (names or IDs). Each workshop must be assigned to exactly one room.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Array of room identifiers. Each room will host exactly one workshop.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin room for a directed room pair (the 'from' room) used when measuring how far attendees must walk between two rooms.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination room for a directed room pair (the 'to' room) used when measuring how far attendees must walk between two rooms.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric distance or travel cost (e.g., meters or walking time) from the source room to the target room; this value is multiplied by attendee transfers to compute movement cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin workshop in a directed workshop pair (the workshop attendees depart from).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination workshop in a directed workshop pair (the workshop attendees arrive at).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Number of attendees who move from the source workshop to the target workshop during the schedule (a nonnegative integer). When two workshops are placed in two rooms, multiply this count by the rooms' distance to get that pair's contribution to total walking cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of maintenance crews and garage bays (each crew occupies exactly one bay and every bay holds exactly one crew).

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the maintenance crews that must be assigned to garage bays (e.g., CrewA, CrewB).

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the garage bays where crews can be stationed (e.g., Bay1, Bay2).

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Source garage bay identifier for a directed bay-to-bay distance (the bay from which travel originates).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Target garage bay identifier for a directed bay-to-bay distance (the bay to which travel is measured).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Distance (e.g., meters or time) between the two specified bays, representing how far crews must move equipment or walk between those bays.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source maintenance crew in a directed interaction (the crew sending equipment or making trips).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target maintenance crew in a directed interaction (the crew receiving equipment or trips).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Amount or frequency of equipment, tools, or supplies exchanged from the source crew to the target crew (higher values mean more frequent or heavier interactions that should be kept closer).

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of specialty teams and ward areas (they are equal). This is the number of distinct teams to place and the number of distinct ward areas to fill; every team must be assigned to exactly one ward and every ward must receive exactly one team.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the specialty teams (e.g., Cardiology, Oncology, etc.). Each identifier represents a team that must be assigned to a single ward area.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the ward areas (physical locations within the hospital). Each identifier names a distinct ward area that can host exactly one specialty team.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source ward area (the starting location for measuring separation). Used together with 'ward_to_id' to specify which pair of ward areas this distance refers to.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target ward area (the ending location for measuring separation). Combined with 'ward_from_id' to identify the ordered pair of ward areas whose separation is given.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of separation between the two ward areas (for example meters of walking distance or travel time). This distance multiplies the patient transfer counts to contribute to the total cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source specialty team (the team sending patients). Used with 'team_to_id' to indicate which ordered pair of teams the transfer count refers to.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target specialty team (the team receiving patients). Together with 'team_from_id' it defines the direction of patient transfers between two teams.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric count (or rate) of patients transferred from the source team to the target team over the chosen time period. These transfer counts combine with ward separations to compute the assignment cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of product categories to place and the same number of shelf zones available; one category per zone.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each product category (facility) to be assigned to a shelf zone — e.g., category IDs or short names.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each shelf zone (location) where a category can be placed — e.g., zone numbers or names.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Source shelf zone identifier (matches an entry in shelf_zones); the row origin for a zone-to-zone distance entry.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Target shelf zone identifier (matches an entry in shelf_zones); the row target for a zone-to-zone distance entry.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of separation between the two shelf zones (e.g., meters or adjacency cost) used to weight cross-category sales penalties.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Source product category identifier (matches an entry in product_categories) for a cross-sales flow entry.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Target product category identifier (matches an entry in product_categories) for a cross-sales flow entry.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric value representing the volume or strength of cross-selling from the source category to the target category; this flow multiplied by zone_distance contributes to the cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of performing acts (bands) and stages; there are exactly this many bands and exactly this many stages to assign (i.e., the size of the assignment/permutation).

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the performing acts (bands) to be assigned to stages; each identifier refers to a single band that must be placed on one stage.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the physical stages/locations available; each identifier refers to a single stage that will host exactly one band.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source stage in a directed distance measurement; together with stage_to_id it specifies which pair of stages this distance applies to (distance from this stage).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target stage in a directed distance measurement; used with stage_from_id to indicate the pair of stages whose separation is given.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numerical distance or travel cost between the two specified stages (how far crew/equipment must move between those stages); used to weight shared-resource movements.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source band in a directed resource-flow entry; the flow describes resources moving or shared from this band to another.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target band in a directed resource-flow entry; paired with band_from_id to indicate which two bands share or move resources between them.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Amount of crew, equipment, or shared-resource movement required from band_from_id to band_to_id (higher means more crew/gear transfers); this multiplies with stage_distance to produce cost contributions.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of research groups and lab rooms (they are equal). This is the number of facilities/locations to assign, so every group gets exactly one room and every room gets exactly one group.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the research groups that must be placed into rooms. Each id corresponds to one 'facility' (research group) in the assignment.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the lab rooms available for assignment. Each id corresponds to one 'location' where a group can be placed.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first room in a room-to-room distance entry. Used together with room_to to specify which two rooms the distance refers to (directed or undirected pair).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second room in a room-to-room distance entry. Paired with room_from to locate the two rooms whose separation is measured.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of separation between the two rooms (e.g., meters, walking time, or an adjacency cost). When two groups are assigned to these rooms, this value weights their collaboration cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source research group in a collaboration-flow entry. Paired with group_to to define a directed or undirected interaction between two groups.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target research group in a collaboration-flow entry. Used with group_from to identify the pair whose collaboration intensity is recorded.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of collaboration intensity between the two groups (e.g., frequency of collaboration, number of shared projects, or communication volume). This value is multiplied by the room_distance for their assigned rooms to contribute to the total cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of services and racks (one-to-one): the number of services to place and the number of rack slots available. Every service must be assigned to a distinct rack.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of service identifiers (e.g., names or numeric IDs). Each entry denotes a service that must be assigned to exactly one rack.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of rack identifiers (e.g., slot numbers or rack names). Each entry denotes a physical rack location that can host exactly one service.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source rack in a rack-to-rack latency measurement; used with 'rack_to_id' to look up the latency between two rack locations.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target rack in a rack-to-rack latency measurement; paired with 'rack_from_id' to identify the rack pair whose distance/latency is given.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Measured or estimated communication latency or cost between the two racks (e.g., milliseconds or normalized hop-cost). This value scales the communication cost when two services are placed at these racks.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source service generating traffic in a service-to-service communication pair; used with 'service_to_id' to identify the communicating services.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target service receiving traffic in a service-to-service pair; paired with 'service_from_id' to identify the communicating services.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Amount of traffic or interaction rate between the two services (e.g., requests/sec or bytes/sec). This value is multiplied by the rack-to-rack latency to compute the contribution to total communication cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of freight categories and dock slots; there are exactly this many categories to assign and exactly this many distinct dock slots (each slot will receive one category).

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of freight category identifiers (one per category) that must each be assigned to a single dock slot; these are the items whose pairwise co-loading interactions generate handling cost.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of dock slot identifiers (one per slot) available for assignment; each slot must receive exactly one cargo category.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source dock slot in a slot-to-slot separation record (the slot where distance origin is measured). Used with to_slot_id and distance to compute how far apart two assigned categories will be.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target dock slot in a slot-to-slot separation record (the slot where distance target is measured). Together with from_slot_id and distance it defines the separation between two slots.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Separation measure between the two dock slots (e.g., meters, steps, or an index-based distance). This value is multiplied by the co-loading frequency of the categories placed in those slots when computing the total handling strain.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source freight category in a category-pair flow record (the category contributing origin flow). Used with to_category_id and co_load_frequency to quantify how strongly two categories should be placed near each other.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target freight category in a category-pair flow record (the category receiving flow). Together with from_category_id and co_load_frequency it describes the directed or undirected co-loading relationship between two categories.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Number representing how often the two freight categories are loaded together (e.g., shipments per day); this flow multiplied by the slot_separation of their assigned slots yields that pair's contribution to the total handling strain.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of class groups and available classrooms (they are equal). The assignment is a one-to-one mapping of these n groups to these n rooms.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each class group (e.g., grade/section codes) that must be assigned to a classroom—one group per room.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each classroom (e.g., room numbers) available for assignment; each will receive exactly one class group.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin classroom in a directed pair (the 'from' room) used in the room-to-room distance list.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination classroom in a directed pair (the 'to' room) used in the room-to-room distance list.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric distance or travel time between the two specified classrooms (e.g., meters or minutes). This multiplies the resource-sharing rate to contribute to the assignment cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source class group in a directed pair (the 'from' group) used in the resource-sharing data.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination class group in a directed pair (the 'to' group) used in the resource-sharing data.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric rate or frequency of resources/shared interactions between the two class groups (e.g., interactions or shared items per day/week). Higher values mean those groups should ideally be placed closer together.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of ground crew teams and apron zones (one team per zone). This is the size of the assignment: the number of distinct teams to place and the number of available apron spots.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each ground crew team that must be assigned to an apron zone. Each entry labels a team used when referencing coordination flows between teams.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each apron zone (parking spots) where a team can be assigned. Each zone id is used when looking up distances to other zones.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin apron zone in a directed distance record. Used to denote the source location when measuring separation to another zone.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination apron zone in a directed distance record. Paired with the source id to describe the separation between two zones.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric distance between the two specified apron zones (source → target). This distance is the spatial penalty used with coordination frequency to compute contribution to total assignment cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the originating ground crew team in a directed coordination record. Used to indicate which team initiates or contributes to coordination with another team.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the receiving ground crew team in a directed coordination record. Paired with the source team id to describe interactions between two teams.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of how often the source team coordinates with the target team (e.g., calls, handoffs per unit time). This directed flow is multiplied by the separation distance of their assigned zones to compute that pair's cost contribution.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of public service offices to place and of municipal buildings available — there is exactly one office per building, so this is the size of the assignment.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each public service office (facility). Each id names a distinct office that must be assigned to exactly one building.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each municipal building (location). Each id names a distinct building that can host exactly one office.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: The id of the source municipal building in a directed pair; used together with the destination_building_id to look up the travel distance from one building to another.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: The id of the target municipal building in a directed pair; together with origin_building_id it locates the distance travelers must cover between that ordered pair of buildings.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: The travel distance (e.g., meters or minutes) between the origin and destination buildings for that ordered pair; this distance multiplies the citizen flow between offices assigned to those buildings to contribute to the total cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: The id of the source office in a directed pair of offices; represents where trips originate when counting citizens moving between offices.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: The id of the target office in a directed pair of offices; represents where trips end when counting citizens moving between offices.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: The number (or rate) of citizens who travel from the origin_office_id to the destination_office_id per time period; when offices are placed into buildings, each such flow is multiplied by the distance between their assigned buildings to compute contribution to total walking cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of microservices and server nodes (they are equal): the number of services to place and the number of available nodes to host them; defines the size of the assignment permutation.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each microservice that must be assigned to a node. Each id represents one distinct service component in the system.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each physical or virtual server node where exactly one microservice will be deployed. Each id represents a hosting location.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Source server node identifier in a node-to-node latency record — the origin of measured latency used when a service placed on this node calls a service placed on the target node.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Target server node identifier in a node-to-node latency record — the destination of measured latency used when a service placed on the source node calls a service placed on this node.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Latency or communication time between the two nodes (e.g., round-trip time or other time units). This value multiplies call volume between services placed on those nodes to compute that pair's contribution to total cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Source microservice identifier in a service-to-service traffic record — the service initiating calls to the target service.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Target microservice identifier in a service-to-service traffic record — the service receiving calls from the source service.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Amount of call traffic between the two services (e.g., requests per second or total number of calls). When two services are assigned to nodes, this value is multiplied by the node latency to produce that pair's cost contribution.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of produce vendors and available stalls in the layout; there are exactly this many vendors and this many stalls so each vendor will occupy one stall and every stall will be filled.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each produce vendor to place; each id represents a distinct vendor that must be assigned to one stall.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each physical stall in the produce section; each id represents a distinct stall that must receive exactly one vendor.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin stall for this distance entry (the source stall location in a directed stall-to-stall distance measurement).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination stall for this distance entry (the target stall location in a directed stall-to-stall distance measurement).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Walking distance between the two stalls (from stall_id_from to stall_id_to), expressed in consistent units (e.g., meters or normalized steps); used to weight how far customers must travel between vendors placed at those stalls.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source vendor in this vendor-to-vendor customer-overlap measurement (one end of a vendor pair).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target vendor in this vendor-to-vendor customer-overlap measurement (the other end of a vendor pair).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Number or weight of customers who visit both vendor_id_from and vendor_id_to (customer overlap); larger values indicate stronger customer sharing and therefore a larger penalty when those vendors are placed farther apart.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of machine types to place and also the number of production cells; each machine type must occupy exactly one distinct cell.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each machine type that must be assigned to a production cell (one-to-one with cells).

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each production cell available on the shop floor; exactly one machine type will be assigned to each cell.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source production cell in a directed cell pair (the origin of a distance measurement between two cells).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target production cell in a directed cell pair (the destination of a distance measurement between two cells).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numerical distance between the two specified production cells (used to weight part flows between machines assigned to those cells).

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source machine type in a directed pair (the machine sending parts to another machine type).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target machine type in a directed pair (the machine receiving parts from another machine type).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Quantity of parts (flow) shipped from the source machine type to the target machine type; when machines are assigned to cells this is multiplied by the cells' distance to compute contribution to total cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of entertainment groups and ship venues — there are exactly this many groups and exactly this many venues, so every group is assigned to one unique venue.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the entertainment groups (e.g., band or act names or numeric IDs). Each identifier names one group that must be placed in exactly one venue.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for ship venues (stages/rooms). Each identifier names one venue that can host exactly one entertainment group.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the source venue in a directed venue pair; used with to_venue_id to specify which ordered pair of venues this distance refers to (distance from this venue to the other).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the target venue in a directed venue pair; used with from_venue_id to specify which ordered pair of venues this distance refers to (distance to this venue from the other).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numerical distance (e.g., walking distance or separation metric) between the two specified venues; when two groups are assigned to these venues this value scales the cost of equipment transfers between them.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the source entertainment group in a directed group pair; used with to_group_id to indicate which ordered pair of groups the swap count refers to (transfers originating from this group).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the target entertainment group in a directed group pair; used with from_group_id to indicate which ordered pair of groups the swap count refers to (transfers received by this group).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Number or frequency of equipment transfers (amps, lights, etc.) from the source group to the target group over the measured period; this is multiplied by the venue separation distance to produce the transfer cost contribution for that ordered pair.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of delivery hubs and depot slots (they are equal). This is the problem size: how many hubs must be assigned, one per fixed slot.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each delivery hub that must be placed into a slot. Each id refers to a specific hub in the parcel-exchange flow data.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each fixed slot in the depot where a hub can be placed. Each slot id corresponds to a physical position used in the distance data.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Source slot identifier for a directed slot-pair: the origin slot in the ordered pair whose separation to 'slot_to_id' is measured.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Target slot identifier for a directed slot-pair: the destination slot in the ordered pair whose separation from 'slot_from_id' is measured.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Physical distance between the two slots (e.g., meters). In the cost calculation this multiplies the parcel flow between the hubs assigned to these two slots.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Source hub identifier in a directed hub-pair: the hub sending parcels to the 'hub_to_id' hub.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Target hub identifier in a directed hub-pair: the hub receiving parcels from the 'hub_from_id' hub.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Number (or rate) of parcels sent from the source hub to the target hub (e.g., parcels per day). This weight multiplies the distance between their assigned slots to produce the contribution to total cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of student-support services and simultaneously the number of distinct buildings available; every service will occupy exactly one building and every building hosts exactly one service.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the student-support teams (services) to be placed — e.g., 'Counseling', 'Registration' — each must be assigned to a unique building.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for campus buildings available to host services; these are the locations to which services will be assigned.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin building in a directed distance record — used together with building_to_id to look up how far students must travel between two specific buildings.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination building in a directed distance record; paired with building_from_id to define the travel separation used when computing referral travel cost.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric distance (e.g., meters or minutes) between the two specified buildings; when two services are assigned to these buildings, this value multiplies their referral flow to contribute to the overall travel cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source service in a directed referral flow record — represents where a student originates when being referred to another service.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target service in a directed referral flow record — represents the service receiving referred students from the source.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric value giving the number (or frequency) of student referrals from the source service to the target service over a defined period; this flow is multiplied by the distance between their assigned buildings to compute contribution to the total travel cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of production departments and soundstages to match — there are exactly this many departments and this many stages, so each department is assigned to one unique stage.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of department identifiers (e.g., 'set_design', 'props', 'wardrobe') that must each be placed at exactly one soundstage.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of soundstage identifiers (e.g., 'StageA', 'StageB') that will each host exactly one department.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin soundstage for a directed distance measurement; used with to_id to locate which pair of stages this distance refers to.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination soundstage for a directed distance measurement; together with from_id identifies the ordered stage pair.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Physical separation or travel cost from from_stage_id to to_stage_id (for example walking distance in meters or expected transit time). This value multiplies prop-transfer frequency between departments assigned to those two stages when computing total hauling cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source department in a directed prop-transfer relationship; used with to_id to specify which department pair the flow refers to.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination department in a directed prop-transfer relationship; together with from_id identifies the ordered department pair.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Rate or count of prop moves from from_department_id to to_department_id over a standard period (e.g., trips per day/week). When assigning departments to stages, this flow is multiplied by the distance between their assigned stages to compute that pair's contribution to total hauling cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of inventory categories to place — equivalently, the number of fixed pallet slots; every category must occupy exactly one slot.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each inventory category (the items/groups to assign to pallet positions). Each identifier represents one category that must be assigned to a single pallet slot.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each fixed pallet position in the warehouse. Each position must receive exactly one inventory category.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source pallet position for this directed distance record (a pallet slot id).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target pallet position for this directed distance record (a pallet slot id).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Distance between the two pallet positions (from_position_id → to_position_id), expressed in the chosen length unit (e.g., meters or walking distance); used to scale cost when categories assigned to these positions are moved together.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source inventory category for this directed co-movement record (the category initiating or observed first in co-moves).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target inventory category for this directed co-movement record (the category paired with the source in observed co-moves).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Measured volume of co-movement from from_category_id to to_category_id over the observation period (e.g., joint picks or units moved together). This value multiplies the distance between assigned pallet positions to contribute to the total layout cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of departments and offices (they are equal): the count of distinct departments to assign and the count of available office locations.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of unique identifiers for each department (each must be assigned to exactly one office).

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of unique identifiers for each office location (each must host exactly one department).

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source office in a directed office pair; used together with to_office_id to describe separation between two offices.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target office in a directed office pair; used together with from_office_id to describe separation between two offices.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric separation (distance) between the two specified offices; when two departments occupy these offices, this distance scales the cost of their interaction.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source department in a directed department pair; used with to_department_id to specify interaction originating from this department.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target department in a directed department pair; used with from_department_id to specify interaction directed to this department.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of interaction (e.g., communication, material transfer) from the source department to the target department; contributes to total cost when multiplied by the distance between their assigned offices.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of artworks and display panels (they are equal). This is the number of items to place — each artwork will occupy exactly one panel.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each artwork to be assigned to a panel. Each id corresponds to one unique work that must appear exactly once.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each display panel (location). Each id corresponds to one unique panel that must host exactly one artwork.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source display panel in a directed panel-pair distance entry; used with panel_to_id to specify which two panels' separation is being measured.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target display panel in a directed panel-pair distance entry; together with panel_source_id it identifies the ordered pair whose separation is given.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Measured distance (or visitor walking cost) between the two panels named by panel_source_id and panel_target_id; this is the spatial component multiplied by co-view counts when computing total visitor circulation cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source artwork in a directed artwork-pair flow entry; used with artwork_target_id to indicate which ordered pair of artworks the co-view count refers to.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target artwork in a directed artwork-pair flow entry; together with artwork_source_id it identifies the ordered pair whose togetherness value is recorded.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: The number of times (or intensity) visitors view the two artworks together — a weight capturing visitor movement affinity. In the layout cost this is multiplied by the distance between the panels assigned to those artworks.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of functional teams and desk clusters (they are equal). This is the number of teams that must each be assigned to a unique cluster.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each functional team on the floor (each team must be seated at exactly one cluster). Use these IDs when specifying interteam call volumes.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each distinct desk cluster available for seating teams (each cluster receives exactly one team). Use these IDs when specifying distances between clusters.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: ID of the source desk cluster in a directed cluster-to-cluster distance record. Together with cluster_to_id, it identifies the ordered pair of clusters whose separation is measured.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: ID of the target desk cluster in a directed cluster-to-cluster distance record. Paired with cluster_from_id to specify which two clusters the distance applies to.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numerical measure of physical separation between the two clusters named by cluster_from_id and cluster_to_id (e.g., meters, walking time, or another distance metric used to convert spatial separation into communication delay).

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: ID of the source team in a directed interteam interaction record. Paired with team_to_id to indicate the ordered team-to-team flow contributing to communication cost.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: ID of the target team in a directed interteam interaction record. Together with team_from_id specifies which ordered pair of teams the flow measurement refers to.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Intensity of interaction from team_from_id to team_to_id (e.g., number of calls, handoffs, or interactions per time unit). This value multiplies the separation distance of their assigned clusters to contribute to total interteam lag.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of research groups to place (equal to the number of buildings); each group must be assigned to exactly one building and each building must host exactly one group.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the research groups that need assignment to buildings; these are the 'facilities' in the assignment problem.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the campus buildings available for assignment; these are the 'locations' that will receive exactly one research group each.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source building for this distance record (a building id from building_ids). Distances are directional if provided as ordered pairs.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target building for this distance record (a building id from building_ids). Used together with from_building_id to locate the pair of buildings.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Measured distance (or travel cost) from the source building to the target building; when two groups are placed in these buildings this distance multiplies their meeting frequency to give that pair's travel burden.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source research group for this collaboration record (a group id from research_group_ids). Flows may be directional (how often group A visits group B).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target research group for this collaboration record (a group id from research_group_ids). Used together with from_group_id to specify the pair of groups.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Directed measure of how frequently or intensely the source group meets or collaborates with the target group; when multiplied by the distance between their assigned buildings it yields that pair's contribution to the total travel burden.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of check-in teams (which equals the number of terminals). This is the size of the assignment permutation.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each check-in team that must be placed at a terminal (the facilities to assign).

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each airport terminal (the locations where teams will be assigned).

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source terminal in a terminal-to-terminal distance entry (the origin of a passenger transfer).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target terminal in a terminal-to-terminal distance entry (the destination of a passenger transfer).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Measure of separation between the two terminals (e.g., walking time or meters). This value multiplies connecting passenger counts to produce transfer inconvenience.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the originating check-in team for a directed passenger flow (where connecting passengers start).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination check-in team for a directed passenger flow (where connecting passengers transfer to).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Count of connecting passengers traveling from the source team's flights to the target team's flights. This directed flow is multiplied by the distance between their assigned terminals to compute contribution to total inconvenience.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct tool types (which equals the number of available bins). This is the size of the assignment: each tool must occupy exactly one unique bin.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each tool type to be placed (e.g., T1, T2...). Each ID denotes a facility in the assignment problem — a specific tool kind that must be assigned to a bin.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each storage bin (e.g., B1, B2...). Each ID denotes a location where exactly one tool type will be stored.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Source bin identifier in a bin-pair description. Use this together with to_bin_id to specify the separation measured from one bin to another.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Target bin identifier in a bin-pair description. Combined with from_bin_id, it defines the ordered pair of bins whose separation is being reported.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Measured separation between the two bins (e.g., number of steps, meters, or relative travel cost) from from_bin_id to to_bin_id. This distance multiplies co-usage counts to produce retrieval interaction cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Source tool identifier in a tool-pair co-usage entry. Together with to_tool_id it identifies which ordered pair of tool types the co-usage frequency applies to.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Target tool identifier in a tool-pair co-usage entry. Combined with from_tool_id, it denotes the pair of tools whose joint usage frequency is recorded.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: How often the two tool types are used together (e.g., number of joint uses or relative frequency). When the two tools are assigned to bins, this count multiplied by the bin_distance contributes to the total retrieval interaction cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of prop sets and backstage rooms. This is the count of items to assign so each prop set is stored in exactly one room and every room holds exactly one prop set.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each prop set (the 'facilities' to assign). Each ID represents a distinct kit that must be placed into a unique backstage room.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each backstage storage room (the 'locations'). Each ID represents a distinct room that will receive exactly one prop set.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin backstage room in a directed room pair; used with 'room_id_to' to specify which two rooms the distance refers to when measuring travel between storage locations.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination backstage room in the directed pair; combined with 'room_id_from' identifies the ordered pair of rooms whose separation is given.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric travel distance or cost between the two specified rooms (e.g., meters, walking time). When two prop sets are assigned to these rooms, this distance multiplies the move frequency between those sets to contribute to the total schlepping cost.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source prop set in a directed pair of prop sets; used with 'prop_set_id_to' to indicate which ordered pair of kits the move count applies to.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the destination prop set in the directed pair; combined with 'prop_set_id_from' identifies the ordered pair whose interaction frequency is recorded.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Number of times (or weight/frequency) that the two prop sets are moved between scenes. This frequency is multiplied by the distance between their assigned rooms to calculate that pair's contribution to total movement cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of crop varieties and fields (they are equal). This is the count of unique assignments to make: one variety per field and one field per variety.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers (names or codes) for each crop variety to be planted. Each variety must be assigned to exactly one field.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers (names or codes) for each physical field on the farm. Each field must receive exactly one variety.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Source field identifier in a distance pair — the starting field for the measured separation between two fields.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Target field identifier in a distance pair — the ending field for the measured separation between two fields.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric distance (e.g., meters, driving time) between the two fields. This weight models hauling/transfer effort when varieties planted in those fields share operations.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Source variety identifier in a directed shared-operation pair — the variety associated with the origin of the measured shared operations or transfers.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Target variety identifier in a directed shared-operation pair — the variety associated with the destination of the measured shared operations or transfers.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of how often the source and target varieties share equipment or management actions (frequency or weight). When those two varieties are assigned to two fields, this flow multiplied by the distance between those fields contributes to the total hauling/coordination cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of interactive displays (and floor spots) to place; every display will occupy exactly one unique spot.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each interactive display that must be assigned to a floor spot.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each distinct floor spot where a display can be placed.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source floor spot in a spot-to-spot distance pair (one end of the measured separation).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target floor spot in a spot-to-spot distance pair (the other end of the measured separation).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Physical distance (or travel cost) between the two named floor spots; used to estimate visitor walking when displays are placed at those spots.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source display in a display-to-display flow pair (one display involved in visitor movement).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target display in a display-to-display flow pair (the other display involved in visitor movement).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Expected amount of visitor traffic between the two named displays; higher values mean more back-and-forth and greater importance to place them close together.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of food vendors and stall locations (there are equal numbers of vendors and stalls). Use this to know how many assignments (a permutation) are needed.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each food vendor that must be assigned to exactly one stall. These IDs are used when referring to flows (how often visitors go between vendors).

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each stall location along the row. These IDs are used when referring to distances between stalls for travel-cost calculations.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: The source stall location identifier (where a visitor would start). Combined with to_id, it identifies an ordered pair of stalls whose separation contributes to walking cost.

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: The target stall location identifier (where a visitor would go). Together with from_id it denotes the pair of stalls used to look up the distance between them.

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric distance between the two stalls (e.g., meters or steps). This value multiplies the visit-frequency between the vendors placed at those stalls to compute walking cost for that ordered pair.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: The source vendor identifier (start of a patron's trip). Used with vendor_to_id to specify an ordered pair of vendors for which visit frequency is recorded.

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: The target vendor identifier (end of a patron's trip). Together with vendor_from_id it identifies how often visitors go between these two vendors.

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of how often patrons visit the two vendors in sequence or the expected co-visit frequency. This multiplies the distance between their assigned stalls to contribute to total walking cost.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of transformer units and substation sites (they are equal): the count of distinct transformers to place and the count of available substation locations.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: List of transformer identifiers (each represents one transformer unit that must be assigned to a unique substation site).

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: List of substation site identifiers (each represents a distinct physical site where exactly one transformer will be installed).

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the origin substation site in a directed site-to-site distance record (the source location of the measured separation).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target substation site in a directed site-to-site distance record (the destination location of the measured separation).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Measure of separation between the two substation sites (used, together with transformer power exchange, to compute transmission loss contribution for an assigned pair).

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source transformer in a directed transformer-to-transformer power exchange record (one endpoint of the measured flow).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target transformer in a directed transformer-to-transformer power exchange record (the other endpoint of the measured flow).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Amount of power exchanged (or interaction strength) between the two transformers; when those transformers are placed at particular sites this value is multiplied by the site distance to yield their contribution to total transmission loss.

global_fields.name: n
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of book categories to place and the equal number of distinct shelving areas available; every category must occupy exactly one area and every area must hold exactly one category.

global_fields.name: facilities
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the book categories (the 'facilities' being assigned). Each identifier refers to one category that must be assigned to a unique shelving area.

global_fields.name: locations
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the physical shelving areas (the 'locations'). Each identifier refers to a unique shelf area that will host exactly one book category.

distance_item_fields.name: from_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source shelving area in a distance record (the starting shelf area for the separation measurement).

distance_item_fields.name: to_id
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target shelving area in a distance record (the ending shelf area for the separation measurement).

distance_item_fields.name: distance
distance_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of separation between the two shelf areas named by shelf_area_from_id and shelf_area_to_id (e.g., meters or walking steps). Used to quantify patron walking effort between categories placed at those areas.

flow_item_fields.name: from_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the source book category in a co-borrowing record (the origin category in the pairing).

flow_item_fields.name: to_id
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the target book category in a co-borrowing record (the other category in the pairing).

flow_item_fields.name: flow
flow_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric value representing how often the two categories (category_from_id and category_to_id) are checked out together. This frequency multiplied by the separation_distance of their assigned shelf areas contributes to the total patron walking effort.
